newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady but mill buying low.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady but mill buying low.

text.p: Indian cotton prices held steady in a narrow price band on Thursday though fresh mill buying remained low and volumes were thin, dealers said.
Traders say the new crop is estimated to be lower at 15.50 million bales after an earlier forecast put it at 17 million bales.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 820/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,400/1,630 rupees per maund. Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) was steady at 17,800/18,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
